items.title: File Einspruch (objection) against the Bußgeldbescheid
items.quote: Binnen zwei Wochen nach der Zustellung dieses Bescheids kann Einspruch eingelegt werden, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Stadt Musterhomburg (Saar) – Ordnungsbehörde.
items.computation: The notice was formally served (Zustellungsurkunde, §182 ZPO); the attached envelope copy is marked 'zugestellt 24.11.2026', so delivery counts as that day and there is no deemed-delivery fiction to apply. Under §187 Abs.1 BGB the day of delivery (24.11.2026, Tuesday) is not counted; the 2-week period starts 25.11.2026. 14 days later (§188 Abs.1,2 BGB) lands on Tuesday 08.12.2026, a normal working day in Saarland, so no weekend/holiday shift applies. The deadline for the objection to reach the authority is 08.12.2026.

items.title: Pay the total fine (Geldbuße, fee and delivery costs)
items.quote: Bitte überweisen Sie den Gesamtbetrag erst nach Rechtskraft, und zwar innerhalb von zwei Wochen.
items.computation: The letter says payment is due only after the decision becomes final (Rechtskraft) and then within two weeks. Rechtskraft occurs once the two-week Einspruch period lapses without an objection being filed, i.e. the day after the objection deadline computed above (08.12.2026) → Rechtskraft on 09.12.2026 (assuming no Einspruch is lodged). Counting the further 'zwei Wochen' from that day under §187/§188 BGB: day of Rechtskraft (09.12.2026) not counted, period starts 10.12.2026, 14 days later lands on Wednesday 23.12.2026, a normal working day in Saarland, so the amount is due by 23.12.2026. This date assumes the recipient does not file an Einspruch; if one is filed, Rechtskraft and the payment deadline are postponed or the payment obligation falls away pending the appeal.

warnings: The payment due date (23.12.2026) is derived from an assumption that no Einspruch is filed within the two-week objection period ending 08.12.2026; if an Einspruch is lodged, the fine does not become final (Rechtskraft) and this payment deadline does not apply.

The sender's e-mail address printed on the letter ('bussgeld@stadt-musterhomburg-(saar)-o.example') contains parentheses, which is not valid in a real domain name — worth checking against the authority's official website before replying by e-mail.

The printed IBAN (DE86 5945 0010 0004 2401 00) is a well-formed German IBAN and passed the checksum check, but this only confirms its format, not who actually owns the account; before paying, compare the payee name shown by your bank's mandatory name-check against the authority's official details.
